Answer D.** A logarithm $\log_a b$ is positive when $a$ and $b$ lie on the same side of $1$, and negative when they lie on opposite sides. $0 < \log_{3}2 < 1$ is correct. $\log_{3}1 = 0$, $\log_{3}3 = 1$ and $1 < 2 < 3$, so the logarithm lies between $0$ and $1$. $\log_{0.2}0.5 < 0$ is incorrect. The base $0.2$ and the argument $0.5$ are both below $1$, so the logarithm is positive. $\log_{4}0.8 > 0$ is incorrect. The base $4$ is above $1$ and the argument $0.8$ is below $1$, so the logarithm is negative. $\log_{2}3 < 1$ is incorrect. $y = \log_{2} x$ is increasing and $3 > 2$, so $\log_{2}3 > \log_{2}2 = 1$.
